testsuite.name: gspa.integration.workflow.ExperimentWorkflowSpec

testcase.name: evidence-guided: hypotheses come only from candidates that map to a gene and reaction of the model; nothing is invented
cohort context of a candidate becomes experiment evidence only where it was measured
results become conditional features; an objective that requires the candidate is flagged and kept out of the evidence
the experiment stage changes no annotation score and leaves the raw result for the integration step
the solver-call budget is a hard cap and exhaustion is reported, not read as a result
with nothing admissible no solver is started and the ledger says so
masked assignment comparisons run through production and remain conditional
a user-supplied manifest runs as written and the ledger does not claim evidence guidance
guided masked assignments use actual weak candidates and execute all alternatives including null
guided masked assignment without a mapped candidate records abstention and starts no solver
a result for another model, or one that claims a probability, is refused and removed [modelSha: other, probability: None, fragment: different model, #0]
a result for another model, or one that claims a probability, is refused and removed [modelSha: real, probability: 0.9, fragment: claims a probability, #1]
inconsistent experiment and community options are rejected before anything runs [options: [experimentManifestFile:null, experimentEvidenceFile:THE_FILE], fragment: need experimentManifestFile, #0]

inconsistent experiment and community options are rejected before anything runs [options: [experimentMode:manifest, experimentEvidenceFile:THE_FILE], fragment: only applies to experimentMode evidence_guided, #1]
inconsistent experiment and community options are rejected before anything runs [options: [experimentMode:guess], fragment: experimentMode must be one of, #2]
inconsistent experiment and community options are rejected before anything runs [options: [experimentMaxSolverCalls:0], fragment: must be positive, #3]
inconsistent experiment and community options are rejected before anything runs [options: [communityTimeoutSeconds:0], fragment: must be positive, #4]
the agent strategy is only forwarded as options: model and endpoint, never a credential, and no call is made here
an output left by an earlier run is never mistaken for this run
exact xrefs choose the media; a protein absent from the model is tested as a reaction and its alternative ECs stay separate
a broad EC and shared EC are ambiguous, never individual activity or exclusive competition
the same model in an acetate medium asks different questions and gives different answers
baseline context is honest when no condition changes anything and unavailable when it could not be run
community: organism-specific, bounded, no gene assigned and no candidate feature fabricated
community: a result that assigns an enzyme or was computed on other models is refused [aSha: bad, assignment: none, fragment: different model, #0]
community: a result that assigns an enzyme or was computed on other models is refused [aSha: real, assignment: EC:1.1.1.1, fragment: assigns an enzyme, #1]

a failing, silent, stale, slow or mismatched sidecar fails the stage and never yields a result [body: import sys; sys.stderr.write("solver exploded"); sys.exit(3), timeout: 30, fragment: status 3, #0]
a failing, silent, stale, slow or mismatched sidecar fails the stage and never yields a result [body: pass, timeout: 30, fragment: wrote no output, #1]
a failing, silent, stale, slow or mismatched sidecar fails the stage and never yields a result [body: import time; time.sleep(20), timeout: 1, fragment: exceeded, #2]

a failing, silent, stale, slow or mismatched sidecar fails the stage and never yields a result [body: import sys, json; json.dump({"schema": "other/1"}, open(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--out")+1], "w")), timeout: 30, fragment: schema, #3]
